transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?
Mostly, I’m here because I’m tired in a way that sleep doesn’t really fix. Even simple things, like unloading the dishwasher or reading for my certificate class, can feel like too much.
Along with this tiredness, have you been feeling down, sad, or depressed lately?
I’m not really sure. I’ve mostly just noticed how tired I am.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities you normally enjoy?

Yeah. I’ve kind of stopped caring about the things that normally make me feel like myself—sketching, cooking, yoga, going to gallery openings. Even playing tennis with a friend doesn’t really appeal to me lately.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I’d say it’s been about three months now—the low energy and not really wanting to do anything.
Have you ever had a period like this before in your life?
I’m not sure. I can’t really think of another time it lasted like this.
Did anything particularly stressful happen or change in your life around the time you started feeling this way?
Yeah… around then, my spouse and I started arguing a lot more often. This has all been going on for about four months.
Have you been feeling down on yourself, worthless, or excessively guilty about things lately?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed feeling especially worthless or guilty lately.
Have you been having trouble falling or staying asleep lately?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed any particular trouble with falling asleep or staying asleep.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?
Yeah, my appetite’s been off. Some days I realize I’ve only had coffee and a few bites of food all day. My jeans have gotten looser too, and I wasn’t trying to lose weight.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating, staying focused, or making everyday decisions lately?
Yeah. I’ll open my planning app and just stare at it, not able to decide if I should do a class assignment, pay a bill, or start dinner. Then I end up not doing any of it for a while.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn't worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself?
I’m not really sure what you mean by that. I haven’t noticed anything like that specifically.
Have you or anyone else noticed that you are moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or that you feel unusually restless and fidgety?
On my slower days, it feels like I’m moving through wet cement. Even answering a simple question from my spouse can take me a weirdly long time.
